test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a code language, ‘she is mother’ is coded as 'lim kim nim', 'she likes badminton' is coded as 'lim tim gim', and 'mother plays badminton' is coded as 'nim bim gim'. What is the code for the word 'plays'?
solution:
Here, the following logic is used

‘she is mother’ is coded as 'lim kim nim' and 'she likes badminton' is coded as 'lim tim gim'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3529fa5068242251f4c5bafbc921200edbec6b27f87e56e2885cf8fb55df9b86.png] 

‘she is mother’ is coded as 'lim kim nim' and 'mother plays badminton' is coded as 'nim bim gim'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3bbfd1140f68cdd85cde041c65d294ac45e3fb7b791cdd34947464ba9d069b1.png] 

'she likes badminton' is coded as 'lim tim gim' and 'mother plays badminton' is coded as 'nim bim gim'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a17934c9f84e33adb41db0ef40b5ab3c31769e3b792f4d48adc7673b4466d39f.png] 

Therefore,

'mother plays badminton' is coded as 'nim bim gim

' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b75aa299ee77f4f78b5cc05eb6c22842a1302dfffdb69cdcc6f3411d58043c4d.png] 

The code used for 'plays' is 'bim'

Hence, the correct answer is **option(2) **
